Engine by Starling enters fourth global market with New Zealand’s SBS Bank Engine has today announced a partnership with SBS Bank, a New Zealand-owned mutual, in its fourth international deal. SBS Bank has grown from building society roots to become an established financial institution in New Zealand.

Tangerine and Engine by Starling sign agreement to provide next generation banking for millions of Canadians New agreement to deliver a next-generation banking platform for more than 2 million Tangerine clients in Canada.

Engine by Starling hires Jody Bhagat to lead major North America expansion Engine has named industry veteran Jody Bhagat to lead its expansion into North America, where the company sees significant market opportunities amongst the region’s 4,000+ mid-tier banks and credit unions.

Engine targets the North American market with launch of first subsidiary Engine by Starling, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business born from Starling Bank, has created its first overseas subsidiary in the US as a platform from which it will expand in the North American market.

Salt Bank reaches half a million customers one year since launch Salt Bank, Romania’s first digital bank, has now reached 500,000 customers in just a year since launching on Engine by Starling’s core banking platform. The bank went live in April 2024 having been built in 12 months by teams from Salt, Engine and the key implementation partner GFT.

AMP Bank successfully launches on Engine by Starling platform Engine by Starling has enabled AMP Bank to launch its new mobile-first proposition targeting small businesses and everyday banking customers in Australia.

Engine by Starling named a Challenger in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Retail Core Banking Systems, Europe It is our view that this recognition reflects our ability to partner with banks and implementation partners to meet client delivery objectives on time.

Engine by Starling wins awards for partnership with Salt Bank at Banking Tech and IBSi Global FinTech Innovation Awards Engine by Starling, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) subsidiary of Starling Bank, has won the “Best Use of Tech in Retail Banking” for its collaboration with Romania’s first digital bank, Salt Bank, and GFT.

Salt Bank, Romania’s first digital-native bank, successfully launches on Engine by Starling platform Engine by Starling has launched Romania’s first ever digitally-native bank on its core banking platform. Salt Bank has already onboarded 100,000 Romanian customers, making it one of the fastest growing neobanks in Southeastern Europe.

Engine by Starling forms partnership with GFT to help banks rapidly modernise The partnership will leverage GFT’s deep engineering skills, global reach and strategic focus on modern banking platforms.
Engine by Starling forms a strategic global alliance with PwC The alliance will help banks implement Engine’s cloud-native banking platform as they look to modernise and launch new digital offerings.

AMP to launch new digital bank designed for small business AMP to launch digital bank division built specifically for the transaction needs of sole traders and small business in Australia. AMP to work with Engine by Starling, the SaaS subsidiary of leading UK digital bank, Starling Bank.

Salt Bank selects Engine by Starling to deliver next-generation banking in Romania Salt Bank, Romania’s first digitally-native bank, has selected Engine by Starling, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) subsidiary of Starling Bank, to power its new retail bank.
